tool_calls.input:
const exactCmd = `python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib, re, sys
root = pathlib.Path('.').resolve()
sys.path.insert(0, str(root / 'tools'))
from i18nlib.config import load_manifest
from i18nlib.locale_model import LocaleLoader
from i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime
loader = LocaleLoader(LuaRuntime(load_manifest(version='tome-1.7.6', manifest_path=None)))
current_path = root / 'tome-ashes-urhrok.lua'
baseline_path = root / '.ai/task/repair-w29-20260925/baseline/tome-ashes-urhrok.lua'
before = loader.load_bytes(baseline_path.read_bytes(), logical_path=current_path.name).translations
after = loader.load_bytes(current_path.read_bytes(), logical_path=current_path.name).translations
assert len(before) == len(after), (len(before), len(after))
changed = []
for i, (b, a) in enumerate(zip(before, after)):
    diffs = [k for k in ('source','target','source_tag','args_order','special','section') if b.get(k) != a.get(k)]
    if diffs:
        assert diffs == ['target'], (i, diffs)
        changed.append((i, b, a))
work = json.loads((root/'.ai/task/repair-w29-20260925/WORKSET.json').read_text())['items']
base = json.loads((root/'.ai/task/repair-w29-20260925/BASELINE-records.json').read_text())['tome-ashes-urhrok.lua']
assert len(changed) == len(work) == len(base) == 21, (len(changed), len(work), len(base))
work_keys = {(x['section'],x['source'],x['source_tag'],x['target_preimage']) for x in work}
changed_keys = {(b['section'],b['source'],b['source_tag'],b['target']) for _,b,a in changed}
assert changed_keys == work_keys, (work_keys-changed_keys, changed_keys-work_keys)
conv = re.compile(r'%(?:[-+#0]*[0-9]*(?:\\.[0-9]+)?[diouxXeEfFgGcsq]|%)')
marker = re.compile(r'#\\{[a-z]+\\}#|#[A-Z_]+#')
for i,b,a in changed:
    src, tgt = a['source'], a['target']
    assert src.count('\\n') == tgt.count('\\n'), (i,'LF',src.count('\\n'),tgt.count('\\n'))
    assert [len(x)-len(x.lstrip('\\t')) for x in src.split('\\n')] == [len(x)-len(x.lstrip('\\t')) for x in tgt.split('\\n')], (i,'TAB')
    assert conv.findall(src) == conv.findall(tgt), (i,'printf',conv.findall(src),conv.findall(tgt))
    assert marker.findall(src) == marker.findall(tgt), (i,'markup',marker.findall(src),marker.findall(tgt))
target = next(a['target'] for _,b,a in changed if b['source'].startswith('You did not think it possible for an amorphous mass of bubbles'))
assert '#AQUAMARINE#"%s纳鲁精灵……背叛乌克勒姆斯维奇……我可不是傻瓜…… "#WHITE#' in target
assert '背叛纳鲁精灵……' in (target % '背叛')
assert '屠戮纳鲁精灵……' in (target % '屠戮')
heart = next(a['target'] for _,b,a in changed if b['source'].startswith('Draw in the raging fires'))
assert '半径 10' in heart and '半径 5' not in heart
print(f'LuaJIT-loader entries: baseline={len(before)} current={len(after)}')
print(f'changed_targets={len(changed)} non_target_field_changes=0 workset_exact=true')
print('walrog_runtime=背叛纳鲁精灵/屠戮纳鲁精灵; refuted_radius=10')
PY`;
const calls = [
  tools.exec_command({cmd: exactCmd, workdir:"/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation", yield_time_ms:30000, max_output_tokens:8000, sandbox_permissions:"require_escalated", justification:"是否允许我用项目 manifest 的 LuaJIT loader 对 task baseline 与当前文件做精确差异验证？"}),
  tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 -B tools/i18n lint --strict", workdir:"/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation", yield_time_ms:30000, max_output_tokens:8000, sandbox_permissions:"require_escalated", justification:"是否允许我运行用户要求的 strict lint（会在忽略的 .artifacts 目录生成报告）？", prefix_rule:["python3","-B","tools/i18n","lint"]}),
  tools.exec_command({cmd:"git diff --check", workdir:"/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation", yield_time_ms:30000, max_output_tokens:4000, sandbox_permissions:"require_escalated", justification:"是否允许我运行用户要求的工作树空白错误检查？", prefix_rule:["git","diff","--check"]})
];
const results = await Promise.all(calls);
results.forEach((r,i)=>{ text(`--- check ${i+1} ---`); text(r.output); text(`exit_code=${r.exit_code}`); });
